args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks in production following deployment of v2.3.1 (the latest deploy). As remediation, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of 0.002. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until fixed.
